sense.text:
“Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.” All the diseases our forefathers had in Egypt, the Lord says he will bring upon us.

This is the scripture for what came out this week in the congressional hearing on Fauci, that genocidal maniac, and the gain-of-function research behind the diseases our people are dying from today. He keeps pleading the fifth, and Biden gave him a blanket pardon: if he did nothing wrong, why would he need a pardon? The virus they said came about naturally was made by gain-of-function research. People were kicked out of college and could not work unless they took the shot, and now millions are dropping dead from heart attacks, blood clots and all types of diseases that came from it. Fauci is being used as the fall guy. The last three presidents all pushed that vaccine. This is bigger than Fauci: the shadow governments, the spiritual wickedness in high places, decided to vaccinate 80% of the people on the planet. It was not a pandemic, it was a plandemic.

“Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law”: sicknesses that are not written in the Bible, that our forefathers never knew about back then. That means new sicknesses and new plagues, things that were going to be created. Man-made.

Like what? Ebola, HIV AIDS, the coronavirus. All of that is gain-of-function research, things the white man created. A lot of these diseases were created by Edom through gain-of-function research, to kill us and to destroy us.

“Them will the Lord bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.” That is a curse the Lord said would fall upon us.

When did the beginning of sorrows start? To answer it we first have to learn how to read the times. The Pharisees and the Sadducees came tempting Christ, wanting him to “shew them a sign from heaven.”

“When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.” In the evening, when the sun is about to go down, you can look up at the sky, see it red, and tell it is going to be fair weather.

“And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring.” In the morning you go outside, see the sky full of clouds, and you can tell it is going to rain today. “Ye can discern the face of the sky.” We are able to do that.

“But can ye not discern the signs of the times?” That is what we have to learn: to discern the signs of the times. The Most High gave us signs to look for, so that we know what time we are living in. In Matthew 24 the apostles asked Christ what signs to look for before he returned, and he went over them.

We tell what time we are living in by the signs. “Measure thou the time diligently in itself: and when thou seest part of the signs past, which I have told thee before”: when you see part of the signs the Lord told about pass away, meaning fulfilled.

“Then shalt thou understand, that it is the very same time, wherein the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made.” The things taking place on the earth are letting us know that the Highest has begun to visit the earth. Another name for that time is the beginning of sorrows. We are living in the time when the Lord is visiting the world that he made.

Read it again after Genesis, Exodus and Revelation: after that 400 years in spiritual Egypt, after 2019, the Most High God has begun to visit the world.

“Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes”: are we seeing earthquakes taking place all over the world? “And uproars of the people in the world”: are we seeing uproars among the people all over the world? Yes. The Highest has begun to visit the earth he made.

“Then shalt thou well understand, that the most High spake of those things”: the earthquakes, the uproars, the wars, the things we see taking place right now. God spoke about it “from the days that were before thee”: the time of Daniel, of Jeremiah, of Isaiah, and “even from the beginning”, all the way back in Genesis.

We are living in a great time. But we must be able to discern the signs of the time: the time when the Lord has begun to visit the earth. We know it by the earthquakes, the famine, the wars and the uproars among the people.

“For like as all that is made in the world hath a beginning and an end, and the end is manifest: Even so the times also of the Highest have plain beginnings in wonders and powerful works, and endings in effects and signs.” There will be serious effects and signs on this earth at the end of this world: sorrows, pain, things you cannot even imagine. Like the effects in a movie theater, the end of this kingdom is going to come with signs and effects. The key to understanding the times we live in is reading the signs.

“And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith”: by your works, meaning by keeping the commandments, by doing what is right, by dealing right with your brothers, by doing what God commands you to do; and by faith, by believing in the Lord.

If you believe, and have faith and works, you “shall be preserved from the said perils.” The perils are the great effects, the danger, the sorrows coming upon the earth. And you “shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning.” We were chosen by the Lord from the beginning.

precepts.why:
We discern the signs of the times by what we see happening on the earth, and the Lord gave a time to measure by. To Abram: “thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs”. We would be strangers in a land that is not ours, “and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years”.

The prophecy said we would be in Egypt serving the Egyptians four hundred years.

“Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years. And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the Lord went out from the land of Egypt.”

We just read four hundred years, but we came out at four hundred and thirty. Does the Lord lie? Is the Bible contradicting itself? No. Exodus 3 shows what took place in those years: the Lord began to visit. When the Lord deals with his salvation, his time is his time; no man knows the day or the hour.

When the Lord came unto Moses he said, “I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” Then: “I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows”.

When we were in Egypt, God came down and saw what the Egyptians were doing to us, and heard our cry. That is the Lord visiting us in Egypt. After the four hundred years he came, saw our affliction, and began making preparation to deliver us out of ancient Egypt. That is what it means for the Highest to begin to visit.

“The great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt.” The great city is America. Why spiritually? Because everything that happened to us in ancient Egypt has happened to us here in America. Ancient Egypt had its Jim Crow, and so did America. We were slaves working the fields there, and slaves working the fields here. That is why the Bible calls this place spiritual Egypt.

Genesis 15 speaks of ancient Egypt, but we have been slaves here in spiritual Egypt for over four hundred years, and 2019 made the four-hundred-year mark. Everybody saw the world change after 2019: COVID-19 and the world shut down for two years; the Russia-Ukraine war with millions dead; the Congo; after October 7th, 2023, the Israeli government destroying the whole of Palestine, then going to war with Lebanon, then with Iran. Everything changed: white people saying they don’t want migrants in their countries, riots, January 6.

What is happening after that four hundred years? The Lord is visiting the earth, and the Bible calls it the beginning of sorrows. That is not saying we will be here 430 years. It is saying we are living in the beginning. The same way the Lord came down after four hundred years in ancient Egypt, saw our affliction and began preparing our deliverance, he is putting things in place now to destroy this place and deliver us out of here. All the wars we see are God making preparation to deliver us.

How does the Lord begin to visit the world he made? “Behold, saith the Lord, I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.” The sword is war; famine also comes through war. Who is doing this? The Lord. The Lord is the one bringing the plagues upon the world, and the scriptures also call it the beginning of sorrows.

There were always wars, always death, always famine, but after 2019 it has been amplified: the Russia-Ukraine war with millions dead, the coronavirus with millions dead, babies blown up in Palestine. Everybody is in sorrow. Those living in America or in regions where the war is not yet taking place are happy, going to work, living a good life, not worried about anything yet. That is why Christ says it is the beginning.

“For wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth, and their hurtful works are fulfilled.” All the hurtful works they committed here in America are fulfilled. “The innocent and righteous blood crieth unto me, and the souls of the just complain continually”: they will be killing us here in America. “I will surely avenge them”: the Lord will avenge us.

“Behold, my people is led as a flock to the slaughter”: in the future we will be led as a flock to the slaughter here in Babylon. “I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt”: America is spiritual Egypt, as Revelation 11:8 says. “But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before.” The same way he smote Egypt with plagues before, he will do it again to this spiritual Egypt, after that four hundred years.

We could be here another fifteen or twenty years. But know that this is the time when the Lord begins to visit the earth, and we know it by the plagues. The Lord is preparing to deliver his people from the land of Egypt, from mystery Babylon the great. The wars sparking up are the events that must take place for that deliverance, and for Babylon to be destroyed.

sense.text:
The disciples came to Christ privately: “Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming”: what signs do we look for before you return? This is Matthew 16 again: if you can read the sky and say it is going to rain today, you should be able to watch the signs and tell what time you are living in.

“And of the end of the world”: the end of this world, meaning the destruction of the people ruling the earth today. Christ explains what we must look for before that end.
“Take heed that no man deceive you.” Don’t let anybody deceive you.

“For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” Who came in the name of Christ? The Christians and the Jews. They call themselves Jews, they call themselves Christians, they say they are following him, that they are anointed, that they are the chosen people. In Revelation they are called the false prophets: Christianity and Judaism are the false prophet.

And they have deceived the whole earth: those that call themselves Jews, and the white people that call themselves Christians and the people of Christ. Ask anybody on earth what Christ looks like and they will say a white man.

“And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars.” Before Christ returns there will be a false religion sitting upon the earth claiming to follow him, and those same people will cause a bunch of wars on the earth.

“See that ye be not troubled”: don’t be worried, brothers and sisters. “For all these things must come to pass”: everything taking place now is a buildup. The Lord began to visit the earth in 2019, the four-hundred-year mark, and he is making preparation to deliver his people out of Egypt.

“But the end is not yet.” We are not living in the end as yet. We are living in the time of the signs.

“For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom”: we see nations rising against nations and kingdoms fighting kingdoms right now. “And there shall be famines”: famines are taking place all over the earth because of these wars, and they are going to get worse in the next couple of years, with the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea closed, and the oil that the fertilizer for the crops comes from.

“And pestilences”: Ebola, the coronavirus. “And earthquakes, in divers places”: in different places.

“All these are the beginning of sorrows.” When you see earthquakes in diverse places, hear of all kinds of diseases with people dropping dead from the coronavirus and Ebola, see kingdoms rising against kingdoms and hear of wars and rumours of wars, that is the time we are living in right now: the beginning of sorrows.

The Lord left the signs in the Bible. The beginning of sorrows is the Lord beginning to visit the earth; it is what comes after the four hundred years, the Lord preparing to deliver us out of here. Russia and Ukraine, Iran, Palestine, Lebanon, the Congo, earthquakes all over the world: when you see these things, it is just the beginning. The end is not yet.

precepts.why:
Matthew 24 and 2 Esdras 16 say the same thing. “Like as an arrow which is shot of a mighty archer returneth not backward: even so the plagues that shall be sent upon earth shall not return again.” Who is sending the plagues upon the earth? The Lord.

“Woe is me! woe is me! who will deliver me in those days?” Ezra saw himself in these times, because so much death, destruction and pain is coming to the earth. Yet a lot of us are in la-la land worrying about the wrong things, watching the signs and the world changing and still not paying attention. Millions died these last couple of years; Fauci is the fall guy for a pandemic that killed millions; millions of you took the shot because you trusted your job, and you had better pray and fast and get that crap out of your system. Now they turn around and say you shouldn’t have taken it. Don’t trust white people. Stop trusting these people.

“The beginning of sorrows and great mournings”: when the plagues start to be sent on the earth is when the Lord begins to visit the earth he created, and the Lord calls those times the beginning of sorrows. What kind of sorrow? Things are going to happen on this earth you can’t imagine. Serious oppression is going to be raised up here in America. The comfortable life our people have in America is done; it is going to disappear. There will be great mourning all over the world.

“The beginning of famine and great death”: everybody is eating good now, but this is the beginning of famine. Over fifteen million died worldwide from the coronavirus, two to three million in the Russia-Ukraine war, over a hundred thousand in Palestine. That is great death, and it is only the beginning. Do not think you will be in America, or whatever country you are in, and everything will be okay. That sorrow is going to take place all over the world.

“The beginning of wars”: there were always wars, the Iraq war, the Vietnam war, many wars. So why does it say the beginning? Because there is a point in history when things begin to get worse and worse, and that point is after the four hundred years, after 2019. These are the wars that lead up to Armageddon. The war in which Palestine was conquered and bombed began it, and it is not going to stop: the Arabs will not sit back and let them take Palestine. America and Israel just radicalized millions of soldiers for that army. Palestine has become radicalized, Lebanon the same, and much of the Arab world will be. Before 2019 the whole world loved the fake Jews and called you anti-Semitic; now the whole world says these people are evil, genocidal maniacs. Russia-Ukraine, Gaza, Lebanon, Iraq, the Iran war: all of it is the beginning of wars leading up to the war of Armageddon. “And the powers shall stand in fear”: everybody is going to stand in fear.

“The beginning of evils!” Evils are about to multiply on this earth; you see the white rednecks running around chanting, get out of my country. “What shall I do when these evils shall come?” Ezra says that because he knew he would be alive in these last days. Ezra the prophet is here.

“Behold, famine and plague, tribulation and anguish, are sent as scourges for amendment.” The wars, the famine, all of it, the Lord sends as scourges, as judgment on the nations. “But for all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness”: Americans will not change, the Palestinians are still worshipping Allah, the people that call themselves Jews will not repent and say sorry for what they stole. Even many of our own people in America will not turn. They will get worse.

“Nor be alway mindful of the scourges”: because it happens on one side of the world, stops, then happens on another side, like a woman in travail. Today a lot of us get up in the morning and don’t think about Iraq, Iran, or the Congo where kids are being raped, because we have a roof and we are comfortable and safe. It is not going to be like that all the time.

“Behold, victuals shall be so good cheap upon earth, that they shall think themselves to be in good case”: food and clothing are cheap in America, so you think you are good. But the prices of food are going up and will get very high. Those that have money right now had better be buying and storing things up.

sense.text: “And when he had opened the fourth seal.” What seal are we living in? The beginning of sorrows is the fourth seal. The fifth seal, the one after it, is when they start killing us here in America.

“And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him.” The pale horse represents the fourth seal, and the fourth seal is the beginning of sorrows.

“And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth.” The them is America, and the fourth part of the earth is America; their own books call America the fourth part of the world. This lets us know who will be responsible for all the death, famine, diseases and wars we will see taking place on the earth: America. They bring death.

“To kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.” Sword is war, hunger is famine, and there will be much death. The beasts of the earth is gain-of-function research, zoonosis: diseases like Ebola and the coronavirus created from beasts, from animals. We read all these things in Matthew 24. We are living under the fourth seal, and America will be responsible for all the death, war and famine on the earth.

“And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held”: killed here in America, for the word of God and for the gospel of Christ that we taught.

“How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?” We want vengeance on the people here in America. So the fourth seal is the beginning of sorrows, and the fifth seal is the saints being killed, us being killed here in America.

precepts.why:
This proves who the fourth seal is. “In the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve”: that is us, the Israelites. “Thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon”: the king of Babylon is America.

“How hath the oppressor ceased!” America, Babylon, is the oppressor, bringing oppression on its own citizens, on Europe, on Iran, on everybody on the earth. That is what we are seeing right now, and that is the fourth seal. “The golden city”: America is the richest country on the earth. “The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers”: the oppressor is also called the wicked.

“He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”: that is what America is doing to Iran, to Saudi Arabia, to all nations. They are the ones starting all these wars, creating famine through the wars, unleashing bioweapon diseases on the earth, and causing great death. America caused the war in Russia and Ukraine by trying to expand NATO; America and Israel caused the war with Iran and Lebanon. “He that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth”: when he is destroyed, nobody cares.

“The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.” When America is destroyed the whole earth will be at rest and singing. “The cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us”: that is what Lebanon will say, because right now Lebanon is being bombed by the Israeli government.

“Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming”: the nations at the bottom will all rise up against America. America oppresses all nations, as we saw in Venezuela and Cuba, and all the nations will rise up against her. “It hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.”

“Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?” This shows America is in decline. The nations watched when America left Afghanistan under Biden; now Iran is giving them a run, and Russia and China are watching. There will also be civil war here in America that weakens her: the fight between the Democrats and Republicans will spill out into a physical war. Once the nations see America is weak, they will rise up and destroy America and Israel.

“Thy pomp is brought down to the grave”: your pride is brought down.

“They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble”: what man? The white man, America and Israel, for they are one. The fourth seal is America oppressing all nations and causing war, death and famine, and here the nations say it. They made the earth tremble by dropping bombs on everybody.

“That did shake kingdoms”: right now Iran is being shaken. “That made the world as a wilderness”: look at Palestine, a wilderness, and it is going to get worse, because we are only in the beginning of sorrows. “And destroyed the cities thereof”: the king of Babylon, America, is behind it, and will be the cause of all the wars and death we see on the earth.

“That opened not the house of his prisoners”: we are his prisoners, and he will never let us go. A lot of us think we are free. We were never free.

“All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house”: after America is destroyed, everyone will be in his own land. “But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch”: this place will be destroyed and cast out like an abominable branch.

The fourth seal is America starting wars, causing famine, causing diseases and death all over the earth: America turned into the oppressor, the king of Babylon. Here is why it is called Babylon. “Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand”: America is that golden cup in the Lord’s hand.

“That made all the earth drunken”: all the earth is drinking of that cup, drunk with their lies, their falsehood, and with affliction, oppression, war, death, destruction and famine. “The nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.” Why are the nations mad? Because they drank that wine, and the wine is nothing good: it is oppression, affliction, war, judgment, America dealing unjustly with all nations.

God used ancient Babylon to bring judgment on all the nations back then, including us, and the same way he will use America today to bring death, destruction and judgment on all nations, wars and rumours of wars and famine. Who is using America to do that? The Lord, who rules in the kingdom of men. Who is sending the plagues on the earth? The Lord.

“Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand”: the cup is the Lord’s fury. So when the Lord says Babylon has been a golden cup in his hand, it is his fury: the fourth seal, America bringing death, famine and destruction on the earth through wars, as we see taking place right now.

“And cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it. And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.” The cup is the sword the Lord sends among all nations. How did he send the sword among the nations back then? He used Babylon. Babylon came and conquered Egypt, destroyed us, destroyed the Philistines; all the land Babylon came and conquered.

The same way God used ancient Babylon as his cup and his sword to bring judgment on the whole earth, he is using mystery Babylon the great. They have that golden cup, and they are bringing forth the fury, death and destruction on all nations, including their brothers in Europe, who are going to feel it too. That is the beginning of sorrows, the time we are living in right now.

“Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.” This Babylon is America: mystery Babylon the great, the mother of harlots. The nations are already rich. China is rich, Saudi Arabia is rich; they got that way in the last forty to sixty years by trading with America. The time for them to get rich has passed, and now they are rebelling against America.

Verse 3 tells why Babylon is destroyed: “For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.” That is the cup with the fury of the Lord, the fourth seal. America is the oppressor, the same way ancient Babylon was, and the Lord used ancient Babylon to oppress all nations. That is the beginning of sorrows. Mystery Babylon is the golden cup in the Lord’s hand, used with the fury of the Lord to judge all nations and bring death and destruction on the earth. As Jeremiah 51:7 says, the nations are mad because they drank of that cup: affliction, falsehood, lies, the wrath of God poured upon all nations, wars and famine.

“And the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.” They are already rich.

“Come out of her, my people”: this is speaking to us here today in Babylon. It is not talking about leaving the country. It means separate yourself from the lies being pushed here in Babylon, “that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” Plagues are coming here to America, and you don’t want to receive them. Get rid of Christmas, get rid of Easter, stop following Christianity. Jesus Christ was not a white man. Come out of all the lies that were taught to you in slavery.

sense.text:
They bombed Iran and the gas prices went up, and every one of them says the same thing: short-term pain for long-term gain. That is not what the Bible says. There will be no short-term pain. There will be pain upon pain, long-term pain with no gain. They started the war and now they are trying to pull out of it, but they can’t, because the Lord is behind it. The Lord wants America to do something very bad to Iran. They are not going to destroy Iran, but the Lord wants America to do exactly what we see it doing. They said it would last five days, then two weeks, and it has been 150 days. Victuals are not cheap anymore. What was done there will cause not a recession but a depression: everybody suffering, no food, famine.

“Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail.” A woman in travail is bringing forth a baby, and as the time gets closer the pain increases, gets stronger, more sorrowful, and closer together. Back in the day some war would pop off every couple of years. After 2019, something crazy happens every year, every month, every week. The daughters of Zion will be in that pain too. The pain comes and may slow down a little, but the closer we get, the more the pains intensify. And the pains are intensifying right now.

“For now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered.” Right here in Babylon, mystery Babylon, the Lord is going to deliver us.

precepts.why:
“Behold the word of the Lord, receive it: believe not the gods of whom the Lord spake.” Don’t believe in those gods the Lord spoke of. “Behold, the plagues draw nigh, and are not slack.” The plagues are that pain coming on the earth.

“As when a woman with child in the ninth month bringeth forth her son, within two or three hours of her birth great pains compass her womb, which pains, when the child cometh forth, they slack not a moment”. Those great pains are the plagues, the death and destruction that will take place on the earth.

“Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth”: war, death, famine, destruction, earthquakes, man-made diseases. “And the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.” The whole world will mourn. On every side: you can’t run to Jamaica, you can’t run to Africa; the pain will come on every side of this earth, including here in America. There will be no short-term pain. The pain will increase and get worse as the time gets close.

“O my people, hear my word: make you ready to the battle”: you had better be preparing. The battle is the plagues and things taking place on the earth, and God says prepare for it. Have a plan, plan A, B and C, even if a plan doesn’t work. Store food, store the things you are going to need.

“And in those evils be even as pilgrims upon the earth.” If you are in Texas and things get crazy in Texas, go to Atlanta. Don’t say you love your big beautiful house you worked your whole life for; you will end up dead. If you have to leave Babylon and go to another country, leave. Don’t get comfortable. Be willing to lose everything, leave everything and go.

“He that selleth, let him be as he that fleeth away”; “he that buildeth, as he that shall not dwell therein”: you build a house and look at it as one you might not live in. “He that soweth, as if he should not reap”: you may plant your farm and not be there to reap it, because you have to flee, because of the pain and the sorrows. “For strangers shall reap their fruits”: they will try to take the goods we prepared.

They said short-term pain for long-term gain. No: the pain is going to increase and increase, and there will be no gain. “Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.” Balm is ointment you put on pain to ease it. Is there any medicine that can stop the pain the Lord is about to send on this earth? Let us see if they can heal themselves from the civil war and all the things coming here.

“We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed”: this place is not going to be healed, and the pains are not going to stop. “Forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country”: everybody will forsake her and go to his own country, “for her judgment reacheth unto heaven”. God is about to judge this great hoe.

“We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.” Don’t let anybody tell you there will be peace on the earth. Death, destruction and famine are coming.

“Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?” Every man holding his stomach like a woman giving birth, and everybody scared.

“Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble”. There will be no other day like it. Jacob’s trouble is coming; great pains are coming. Brothers and sisters, prepare your mind and prepare yourselves for what is coming. That is what the Lord commands us to do.

sense.text: “For the sword and their destruction draweth nigh, and one people shall stand up to fight against another, and swords in their hands.” One people rising up against another with weapons in their hands.

“For there shall be sedition among men”: that is the division we see taking place right now among all nations, in Europe and America. “And invading one another”: Russia just invaded Ukraine, Trump is bombing Iran, Israel just invaded Palestine and Lebanon. We are living in the beginning of sorrows, the time when the Lord said he would begin to visit the earth. “They shall not regard their kings nor princes.”

“A man shall desire to go into a city, and shall not be able.” Why will you not be able to go to certain cities? Because there will be restrictions, division and civil war. America will be divided in the future.
“For because of their pride the cities shall be troubled, the houses shall be destroyed, and men shall be afraid.”

“A man shall have no pity upon his neighbour, but shall destroy their houses with the sword, and spoil their goods, because of the lack of bread”: destroying houses with war, taking your food because of the famine. This is the great pain: as the sorrow intensifies, people will run up in your house and take your food, like the Walking Dead.

“And for great tribulation.” Great tribulation is coming. Don’t sit and think everything will stay good like it is right now, getting up every morning thinking only of your job and your bills. Whether you believe it or not, it is going to happen. My brothers and I are prophets, and by the time some of you realize it, it will be too late.

“Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me”: to show him respect. “From the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus”: Libanus is Lebanon. “To turn themselves one against another”: that is what God wants them to do.

Right now the Houthi rebels are fighting Saudi Arabia. Under Barack Obama, America and the UN let Saudi Arabia go to war with Yemen and starve them out, and America blocked their shipping, and multitudes died of starvation. The only one who helped them was Iran. That is why they are so loyal to Iran and have so much animosity toward Saudi Arabia and the West, and why they shoot missiles at ships. When people say death to whoever, they don’t say it for no reason.

“And repay the things that they have done to them.”

“Like as they do yet this day unto my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense in their bosom.” Even in Ezra’s time they were dealing evil with us. So God will let them fight and kill each other. Why are the Russians and Ukraine killing each other? Why are the Palestinians and the fake Jews killing each other? Why are Iran and America fighting? Because of what they did to us. Don’t be mad and don’t be sad: the wars, the rumours of wars, the famine and the death are the Lord’s judgment for what they did to us. These are not my words.

“My right hand shall not spare the sinners, and my sword shall not cease over them that shed innocent blood upon the earth.” “Woe to them that sin, and keep not my commandments!” Brothers and sisters, those of us that sin and don’t keep God’s commandments: woe unto you, death and destruction.
“Howl ye; for the day of the Lord is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.”

“Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man’s heart shall melt: and they shall be afraid”: everyone is going to be afraid. “Pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them”: of everybody on this earth.

“They shall be in pain”: pain is coming on this earth to the wicked, to all the nations. That is why the Lord said, when you see these things happening, don’t worry; it is the beginning of sorrows. The beginning of sorrows is the Lord judging the nations for what they did to us. “As a woman that travaileth”: the pain will increase and increase and get worse and worse.

“Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate.” The land is America, mystery Babylon, which is going to be destroyed. “And he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.”
“For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened”. There will be so much war that the sun and the moon will be blacked out.
“I will make a man more precious than fine gold”: that is going to be us.
“Therefore I will shake the heavens”: the heavens are the nations. The Lord will shake them, causing them to fight against each other.

“As a sheep that no man taketh up”: nobody is going to help the white man in that day. “They shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.” That democracy bull crap, we are all one people: in the day of the Lord’s wrath, everybody goes to his own people.

This is the destruction of America, and also the destruction of the fake Jews. “Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes”: the Arabs will do this, over there in the land of Israel. “Their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.”

“Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them”: the Persians and the Medes, that is Iran, stirred up against America and Israel. That is what we see taking place right now. Ancient Babylon was destroyed by the Persians and the Medes, and today the Persians and the Medes will also play a role in destroying Babylon.

“Which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.” The Iranians don’t care about your silver and gold; you cannot pay them off like other nations. You killed a man’s father, his child, his wife, and now you want to bargain with gold? He wants vengeance. God is behind all of it.

“Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces”: their bows are missiles. Iran has ballistic missiles piercing American defenses, hitting with growing precision, taking out CIA facilities. “And they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.”

“And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.” Was ancient Babylon destroyed with fire? No, it was destroyed from within. So this Babylon is America, and with it Israel. It shows that Iran will eventually develop nuclear weapons: the same way God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah with brimstone and fire, it will be the same with Israel and America.
